name: Applicant Screening to Slack (Source Check + dossier)

parameters.content:
## Applicant Screening to Slack

**What it does:** an applicant arrives by webhook from your ATS. The flow Source Checks the credentials they claim, pulls a dossier in parallel, formats both into one short summary and posts it to the hiring channel.

**Read this before you use it:** this is decision *support*. Could not verify is not a finding against a candidate - plenty of real credentials are simply not in a public register. The value is that a human reads the evidence instead of the claim.

**Setup**
1. **Applicant Webhook** - POST `{ name, title, employer, notes }` from your ATS to the production URL n8n shows you.
2. Both MentionFox nodes need the **MentionFox API credential** - a key from mentionfox.com/connect, starting `mf_pat_`.
3. **Post to Hiring** - set your channel, or swap for the Send Email node.

**Cost:** Source Check 25 credits, Get Dossier 30.

nodes.name: Applicant Webhook
nodes.notes: POST { name, title, employer, notes } from your ATS.

nodes.name: Source Check
nodes.notes: MCP tool source_check - checks the stated credential against the register that governs it. 25 credits.

nodes.name: Get Dossier
nodes.notes: MCP tool get_dossier - background, roles, public record. 30 credits.

nodes.name: Combine
nodes.notes: Waits for both branches so the summary always has each part.

assignments.name: summary
assignments.value:
={{ '*' + $('Applicant Webhook').item.json.body.name + '* - ' + $('Applicant Webhook').item.json.body.title + ' at ' + $('Applicant Webhook').item.json.body.employer + '

Source Check: *' + $('Source Check').item.json.verdict + '*
Reference: ' + $('Source Check').item.json.report_ref + '

' + $('Get Dossier').item.json.summary }}

nodes.name: Format Summary
nodes.notes: One message, both sources, short enough to actually be read.

nodes.name: Post to Hiring
nodes.notes: Swap for n8n-nodes-base.emailSend if your hiring loop lives in email.
